The '''Chief of Army Operations''' was the formal title for the head of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] and the equivalent of the [[Chief of Naval Operations]]. In [[44 ABY]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] held the position.<ref name="Conviction" />
